summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Lawrence H. White, an American economics professor at George Mason University who teaches graduate-level monetary theory and policy. It describes him as an authority on the history and theory of free banking. It also notes that his writings support abolishing the Federal Reserve System and promoting private, competitive banking.
one_line: Lawrence H. White is an American economist at George Mason University known for his work on free banking and monetary theory.
key_facts: Lawrence H. White was born on November 27, 1954.
Lawrence H. White is an American economics professor at George Mason University.
Lawrence H. White teaches graduate-level monetary theory and policy at George Mason University.
Lawrence H. White is considered an authority on the history and theory of free banking.
The writings of Lawrence H. White support the abolition of the Federal Reserve System.
The writings of Lawrence H. White support the promotion of private and competitive banking.
